size_selection: 640 has highest VAL numbering among inference-only resized models; selected before their held-out scoring
refit_selection: maximum VAL numbering, then coverage, then minimum D13 mean
compressed_candidate_selection: 832 reference plus highest VAL-numbering trained candidate and highest VAL-numbering trained candidate with CPU_AND_NE median <=10 ms; if no candidate <=10 ms, fastest trained candidate. Deduplicate. Uses no held-out scores.
activation_calibration: 32 deterministic scale-v1aug VAL images (sorted filenames, step 47); no held-out frames
tracking_window_selection: 21 or 31 pixels, minimum mean tracking error on VAL synthetic translations (2,1),(-4,2),(8,-3)
tracking_evaluation: actual predecessor-to-labelled-target adjacent pairs plus continuous alternating-inference timing on 09-06, nBpe2 and Stan clips
compression_scope_correction: Graph audit found default compression altered gx/gy coordinate grids and position constants. Preserve non-affine constants, compress conv/linear weights only. Retain original all-constant baseline results; add distinct r832_weights variants. Subsequent candidate compression uses conv_linear scope; no held-out threshold or bit-width tuning.
tracking_resolution_followup: Measured native-image flow cost prompted a separate speed variant: windows 21/31 x long edges 320/640/native, chosen on VAL synthetic motions by minimum mean flow cost among configurations with <=1 source-pixel mean error. No held-out tracking result selects these settings. Preserve the original native-resolution 832 control.
extended_student: Select highest-VAL-numbering 640 student (coverage/D13 tie breaks), initialize independently from its VAL-picked checkpoint, and continue v4q-832 distillation at 512 and 640 for 20 epochs each. Epoch/refit remain VAL-only; one held-out score per checkpoint/runtime/compute mode, plus fixed compression grid. The 640 continuation was declared before either extended run produced a held-out score, motivated by the resized/fine-tuned 512 VAL gap.
compression_shortlist_latency_refinement: Before 512/416 fine-tune held-out scoring, retain original highest-VAL and <=10 ms candidates and additionally compress highest-VAL candidate already <=8.5 ms (near the requested ~8 ms). Track this near-target candidate. This uses VAL and measured latency only; no held-out score enters selection.
